title: ACI Worldwide and Cognizant Complete BASE24-eps Performance Testing on AWS
summary: ACI Worldwide (NASDAQ:ACIW) and Cognizant (NASDAQ:CTSH) announced results from joint performance testing of BASE24-eps, ACI’s card acquiring and issuing software component, deployed on Amazon Web Services. According to ACI Worldwide, the system sustained more than twice the target transaction load for 30 minutes without recording a failed transaction.
